title: fix(studio): offer Customize only on a list view the read-only base ships
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRBPAufqjfhippCo9VshjZw)_
Fixes #35600

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWTpQUNTBdBhmJtCzk

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 里打开只读软件包的对象页面时,在应用中新建的列表视图不再出现「定制」按钮,属性面板改为说明它是本部署自建的视图、应在应用的「管理视图」里编辑;安装包自带的视图照旧可以定制。
- 替中文客户解决「控制台新建的视图到 Studio 定制、加一列后保存报 403」的问题,这是「视图按岗位分配」那张需求卡里拆出来的第二项。
- 万一判断有误,管理员只会在 Studio 里看不到某个视图的「定制」按钮,视图只读、不写入任何数据;直接撤回本改动即可恢复原状。
- 无

## What changes

On a read-only base, an `object` leaf's page in Studio lists every list view of the object: the base's, views created in the app (the console's New view, a package-less row), and views the pair adds. Customize declares an override of the BASE's view (ADR-0146 D2), and the server refuses that declaration for a view the base does not ship (`NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, 403, "declares an override of …, which ships no view named …"). Studio offered Customize on every listed view, so the first saved edit of a console-made view answered 403.

- `useServedOverride` (StudioCustomizeControls.tsx) already reads the layered read at the base for the item. It now also reports what that read served (`shipped`): `base` (a code layer: the base ships the item), `environment` (no code layer, a row stored in this environment: an item no package ships, ADR-0146 D11 environment metadata), `none`, or `null` (not read, or failed). No new request.
- The object page's list-view gate (StudioDesignSurface.tsx, `listViewCustomizable`) offers Customize only when the pair already declares an override of the view or the base ships it. Otherwise the view stays read-only and nothing is written.
- The list-view panel (ObjectListViewInspector.tsx) takes a `readOnlyNote` in place of the package-read-only sentence: for an `environment` view it says the view was created in this deployment and is edited in the app (Manage views, then the view's menu, Edit view config — measured in the console); for `none` it says the base does not ship the view.
- Two new Studio strings, en and zh (`engine.studio.inspector.listView.environmentView`, `…notShipped`).

Route taken: the card's second arm ("does not offer Customize on it and says where it is edited"). The first arm (edit in place at the package-less address) was measured and not taken: the server's package-less draft door admits the write (200, env-wide draft), but Studio's Publish on a read-only base publishes the pair's drafts, so such a draft would sit unpublishable from Studio, and ADR-0146 records "No package-less authoring destination survives". The server refusal is unchanged.

Branch: `claude/project-thread-5bri48` is harness-assigned (the repo convention would be `claude/issue-35600-…`); noted for the Duplicate Fix Guard.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.customizePackagelessView-35600.test.tsx`, through the mounted pillar, the real header controls and the real ensure-door client; the metadata double's layered read answers as the server measured for each kind of row, and its draft door refuses an override of a view the base does not ship (403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`):

- a view created in the app: no Customize, nothing asked or sent, the panel note carries reason `environment` and its sentence;
- a view nothing at the base serves (a pair-added view): no Customize, nothing sent, reason `none`;
- CONTROL: the base's own view is customized into the pair with `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, and the save is not refused.

<details><summary>Test and typecheck readings (head 229fe864)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.customizePackagelessView-35600.test.tsx packages/i18n/` → Test Files 105 passed (105), Tests 1959 passed, 13 skipped (at 229fe864)
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` → Test Files 350 passed (350), Tests 2727 passed (2727) (at e0ccaad8; the later commits are the changeset and one module-top import in the new test file)
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` → VERDICT command-exit 0; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new test file (1 hit)
- Ablation (committed fix, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, source imported directly so no dist build): gate replaced by `listViewAsked;` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 0d83f69d → d407def9) → the `environment` case went red (1 failed, 2 passed); restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The `none` case and the CONTROL stay green under the ablation: the pair-added view has no row read at the base, so its header offers no Customize either way; that case pins the note.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Measured on a running server (examples/app-crm, booted code package `com.example.crm` as the read-only base): the console's New view sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/NAME?mode=draft` with no package; the published view is served with no `_packageId`; `?package=com.example.crm` lists it not; the object's merged `listViews` in the console carry no `_packageId` (the entry is the flattened config), so they cannot answer the question. The layered read at the base answers it: code layer for the base's views (also when the pair overrides them), `code: null` plus the environment row for the console-made view, 404 for a pair-added view and for a default view the base does not ship.
- The same 403 path held for two more views on the object page, and the same predicate covers them: a default view the base does not ship (Customize on it would declare an override of nothing) and a view the pair adds (its own item, which the rail's "Form and list views" entry opens and saves in the pair). On the object page both are now read-only with the `none` note. Whether the object page should edit a pair-added view in the pair (no declaration): the seat answered A, it stays read-only on the object page and the rail entry edits it.
- Re-declared (claim correction on #35600, seat-directed): the two new strings widen the published `@object-ui/i18n` key set, so this PR is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; the claim's file surface adds `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`. The changeset is `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- Not a regression: a default list view the read-only base does not ship (the synthesized all-records view) can no longer be customized from the object page; before this PR its first save answered the same 403, and making one would be a new pair item, a product choice not taken here.
- Observation, filed as #35624 (measure first): right after the console's New view, the console's draft preview bar read "no unpublished changes" while the drafts feed listed the new package-less draft; read once, not reproduced.

## Verification

- Read first: StudioDesignSurface.tsx `listViewCustomizable` / `listViewNotShipped` (the gate; risk: a base view the layered read fails to serve loses Customize, read-only, nothing written); StudioCustomizeControls.tsx `useServedOverride` (`shipped` from the same read; the leaf, navigation and page callers ignore it); the new test file.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.customizePackagelessView-35600.test.tsx` → 3 passed.
- Browser, before and after (examples/app-crm, console Vite dev server on this branch): before, Studio offered Customize on "Verified domestic accounts" (created through the console's Add new view) and adding a column answered `PUT …?package=com.example.crm.custom` 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; after, no Customize, the panel says where the view is edited; CONTROL "All Opportunities" (the base's) still customizes, `PUT …?package=com.example.crm.custom` 200.
